body.statement: On the complete rank-one alternating-factor calibration array with \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}=1/2\), let \(p_t=1+\tfrac12(-1)^t\). In the target chart \(I_{it}\times J_{it}\), the exact formula \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi=\sqrt{(3/4+1/n)\{1/2+4p_t^2/(5n)\}}\) implies \(\inf_{i,t}\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi>c_{\mathrm{loc}}\) for all sufficiently large \(n\) and \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi\to\sqrt{3/8}\). Direct contraction of the rank-one projector Hessian against the moving-average covariance in that same chart gives \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}\,\mathbb E[q_{it}(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon)\mid M]\to-6\sqrt{3/2}\,p_t/(5\sqrt5)\), and therefore \(\psi\,\mathbb E[q_{it}(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon)\mid M]\to\kappa^{\mathrm{drift}}_t=-2\gamma(1)p_t(n/m)(1-\rho_{\mathrm{alt}}^2)/(1+\rho_{\mathrm{alt}}^2)^{3/2}=-12p_t/(5\sqrt5)\) for every fixed parity of \(t\in W\). Thus the global-signal limits are \(-18/(5\sqrt5)\) for even targets and \(-6/(5\sqrt5)\) for odd targets, and \(\psi B_2\to-12/(5\sqrt5)\) because the consecutive window contains equally many targets of each parity. For the native masked optimizer with \(\lambda_n=4\sqrt n\log(n+2)\) and \(\psi=n^{4/5}\), the fitted correction removes this drift and \(n\{(gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})-L-\widehat B_2\}\to_{\mathbb P}0\).
body.justification: The explicit parity constants replace an unsupported universal value and make the early kill test reproducible for the precise mask, factor normalization, dependence law, and penalty used by the native optimizer.
body.gap: Neither the independent-noise MNAR theorem nor fully observed leave-neighbor PCA contains this masked rank-projection coefficient.
body.consumer: A closed-form calibration case detects omitted interior overlap or regularization terms before empirical use.

obligation.what_is_open: The final claim that the fitted correction makes the native-optimizer aggregate remainder vanish after multiplication by the panel scale.
obligation.obstruction: The local singular-value and oracle Hessian-covariance contractions are explicit, but transferring them through the penalized masked fixed point at the inverse-panel scale is exactly the unresolved native second-order problem.
obligation.attempted: Computed the local signal normalization, the moving-average covariance, the rank-one projection quadratic map, the parity-specific limits, and their window average. The proximal identity does not by itself bound the corrected native remainder.
obligation.partial_result:
The algebraic part of the calibration is exact.  There are \(3n/4+1\) local rows, and the alternating sequence has average squared numerator \(5/4\).  Consequently
\[
 \lVert u^{\mathrm{cal}}_{I_{it}}\rVert_2^2=\frac34+\frac1n,
 \qquad
 \lVert v^{\mathrm{cal}}_{J_{it}}\rVert_2^2=\frac12+\frac{4p_t^2}{5n},
\]
and the rank-one product formula gives
\[
 \frac{\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}}{\psi}
 =\sqrt{\left(\frac34+\frac1n\right)\left(\frac12+\frac{4p_t^2}{5n}\right)}
 \longrightarrow\sqrt{\frac38}>\frac12.
\]
Also \(\epsilon_{it}=z_{it}+z_{i,t-1}/2\) gives \(\gamma(0)=5/4\), \(\gamma(1)=1/2\), and zero covariance beyond lag one.  To contract the curvature, write the normalized local signal as \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}uv^{\top}\), and for a perturbation \(E\) put
\[
 c_E=(I-uu^{\top})Ev,
 \quad b_E=(I-vv^{\top})E^{\top}u,
 \quad \mathscr D_E=(I-uu^{\top})E(I-vv^{\top}).
\]
The rank-one projection expansion gives the homogeneous quadratic term
\[
 Q_{it}(E)=\frac{\mathscr D_Eb_Ev^{\top}+u c_E^{\top}\mathscr D_E+c_Eb_E^{\top}}{\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}}.
\]
Substitution of \(E=P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon+\ell_{it}(R_{it}\epsilon)E^{it}_{it}\), followed by contraction of same-row pairs at lags zero and one, yields
\[
 \psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}\,
 \mathbb E\!\left[q_{it}(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon)\mid M\right]
 =-\frac{6\sqrt{3/2}}{5\sqrt5}\,p_t+O(n^{-1}).
\]
Dividing by \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi\to\sqrt{3/8}\) gives
\[
 \psi\,\mathbb E[q_{it}(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon)\mid M]
 \longrightarrow-\frac{12p_t}{5\sqrt5}=\kappa_t^{\mathrm{drift}}.
\]
The window length \(n/4\) is even along \(n\in8\mathbb N\), so the window has equally many targets of each parity and \(\psi B_2\to-12/(5\sqrt5)\).  This verifies the signal and oracle-curvature portions of the proposition; it does not establish the asserted \(n\)-scaled remainder for the fitted native optimizer.
